'''Nici Burrén''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] who worked as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] at the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], they served alongside [[Nici (Naboo engineer)|another engineer]] also named Nici.

==Personality and traits==
A human, Burrén had dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> As was customary with the engineers attached to the Royal Security Forces, they wore the issued yellow [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and [[Armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="SWI145" /> Like some of their colleagues, including [[Simon Jabesq]],<ref name="E1VG">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Bernie Jabesq]] and [[Iain]],<ref name="E1:IG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> Burrén had customized their [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] by writing their name in [[Futhork/Legends|futhork]], the informal Naboo script.<ref name="CVG">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
